name: Star Number / Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: Star number bounds positive recursive teaching dimension on every trace and is projection-monotonic.
witness_verification: For the n-singleton class, star number is n-1, whereas every coordinate projection is again a singleton class (possibly with the empty concept) and has positive recursive teaching dimension at most one.
proof: For every S, $\mathrm S(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm S(\mathcal H_{|S})\geq\mathrm{RTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})$. Maximize the right-hand side over S.
